# Tool Calling and Agents {#sec-agents}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**Chapter status: skeleton.** Port from the CME 295-based Agents & Tool
Calling material; add one fully worked minimal agent loop in Python.
:::

**Learning objectives.** After this chapter you can:

- explain tool calling as constrained generation against a function schema;
- write the minimal agent loop (model → tool call → observation → model) from scratch;
- decide when a workflow needs an agent and when a fixed pipeline is safer;
- describe multi-agent patterns and their coordination costs.

An agent is not magic: [it is a while-loop around a language model with
access to functions]{.hl}. Everything else — planning, memory,
orchestration — is engineering around that loop.
